title: The lantern was a flare
plain: The harbour master's log for the fictional port of Nowhere records that a flare was fired from the pilot boat at ten past nine on the evening in 1958 when people say a lantern hung over the harbour. The log is offered as the ordinary explanation of the light.
claims: the light over the harbour was a flare

tellings.quote: a flare was fired from the pilot boat at ten past nine
the pilot boat came back to her berth at a quarter to ten

discussion.text: The Nowhere Gazette says the pilot boat's flare explains every report of the lantern that evening.
Bo Fixture says the flare went up after the lantern had already hung over the harbour for an hour.
